'''Krix Swiftshadow''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I was just saying to my new friends here how boring this place had become since we launched the last of the excess crew into space. And then you arrive to brighten my day.|Krix Swiftshadow|<ref name="SWG:SD" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] by the name of Krix Swiftshadow was present on the [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']], an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] that was captured by the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]&mdash;and self-proclaimed [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]]&mdash;[[Andal Sait]]. Sait had the intention of selling the vessel to the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], of which Swiftshadow himself was a member. However, before these plans could come to fruition, a team of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] boarded the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Swiftshadow after an intense battle against him and nine [[Stormtrooper grenadier/Legends|Stormtrooper Grenadiers]] loyal to Andal Sait.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Krix Swiftshadow was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Krix Swiftshadow was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|"Star Destroyer" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:SD" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]], on [[January 15]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
